verdict.rationale: There is a public GitHub repository for the SDKs, a community comment notes the RCLI repo is MIT-licensed (while the MetalRT engine is commercial), and a user reports filing a bug report, so open-source participation is at least possible. Nothing in the evidence documents how code gets contributed or how contributors are recognized. Missing for 10: contribution guidelines/CONTRIBUTING docs, a documented PR/review process, a collaborator or maintainer recognition path, evidence of external code contributions being merged.
